description: Open, nonexhaustive first-pass coverage after 16 Spanish- and English-language searches, 409 ordered result headers and 64 source cards. Search windows covered Jan. 1–7, Jan. 8–14, Jan. 15–21 and Jan. 22–31, with additional regional, sectoral and episode searches. Coverage remains uneven across regions, sectors and languages; physical episode boundaries and source access remain incomplete. No absence or exhaustive-coverage claim follows.
required_followup: Complete broad, weekly, local/regional and boundary searches; follow each relevant lead to available original reporting and record remaining gaps.

description: PROVEA/Laboratorio de Paz S010 describes a Trujillo Gas Comunal workers’ protest demanding better working conditions and says workers were deprived of liberty, but later says no detentions occurred in protest contexts during January. The opened 2026 Diario de Los Andes report says the case began on 28 January 2021 with four workers detained during a labor-demands demonstration. S061 associates them with the Motatán filling plant but does not identify the protest site. Total turnout, public accessibility, intended demand recipient and physical end remain unknown; DLA/S010 reporting independence is unresolved.
required_followup: Preserve the S010 contradiction and verify the legal-record timeline and reporting origin if further primary or contemporaneous evidence is available. Seek site-specific attendance/public-access, state-target and physical-boundary evidence; do not treat four detainees as turnout or claim S061 is independent corroboration of S010.

description: The opened Espacio Público account confirms a January Alimentos Kellogg workers' protest in Maracay but gives two event-day references: January 7 for a wage protest and January 4 as the day of the protest that led to access restrictions. Descifrado's search result also says January 4, but its exact page returned HTTP 403 and was not read; the sources may share an origin.
required_followup: Seek an independently reported event-day record from a different publisher and reporting origin. Do not retry Descifrado or use its same-origin republication. Keep only month-level dating unless the conflict is resolved.

description: The source reports at least five workers were suspended after the Alimentos Kellogg protest but gives no number of people who assembled.
required_followup: Find a direct event-day attendance statement or organizer record; do not convert suspended workers into protest turnout.

description: The opened source attributes the action to wage and labor-rights demands at a government-expropriated worksite but does not identify who received the demand or establish public accessibility.
required_followup: Seek a statement identifying the intended recipient and whether the gathering was public. Government ownership alone does not settle the state's role as demand target.

description: The source supplies no physical end or evidence of a continuous sequence beyond the January gathering.
required_followup: Search adjacent days and February only for evidence about the same physical episode; do not infer closure from later discipline or reporting.

description: Descifrado's exact page returned HTTP 403 after a web Cache miss. Its body was not read; a same-origin republication is not an allowed substitute.
required_followup: Preserve the access block; rely only on independent accessible evidence and the opened Espacio Público account.

description: The opened Monitoreamos article is dated 20 January 2021 and reports the Lara protest, but the captured lead passages do not independently state the physical assembly day. The search result also placed it on January 20; month-level date is retained pending a contemporaneous event-day statement.
required_followup: Find an event-day account or organizer record that explicitly dates the physical gathering; do not substitute page publication date for occurrence date.

description: Monitoreamos reports at least 18 organizations protesting in Lara, not the number of people assembled; no attendance number or qualitative crowd-size estimate is captured.
required_followup: Seek an attendance statement about individuals from event-day reporting or organizers. Do not convert organizations or their membership into participants.

description: The captured lead identifies a Lara protest outside the Public Ministry but gives no physical end or event-specific state response; its relationship to the Caracas Azul Positivo protest lead is unresolved.
required_followup: Follow local event-day reporting for departure, response and organizer/coordination details; retain the Lara action separate unless evidence supports a coordinated multi-site episode.

description: La Prensa de Lara describes a group of educators at the January 15 Caracas protest but gives no individual count or qualitative size estimate; the 50-person threshold is unverified.
required_followup: Seek event-day attendance evidence for this specific Caracas site. Do not use nationwide worker totals or other city gatherings as this site’s turnout.

description: Several outlets and the FVM called for teacher actions on January 15 at multiple places. The relationship between the Palace of Justice Caracas gathering and other reported venues/regions remains unresolved; same-date reports may repeat one organized action or describe distinct local assemblies.
required_followup: Read contemporaneous local reports and organizer statements to identify specific physical venues, coordination, participant overlap and campaign boundaries before separating or linking actions.

description: The opened Caracas account reports an earlier December detention of teacher Robert Franco but does not report a state response to the January 15 gathering or its physical end.
required_followup: Seek event-specific reporting on any state action at the gathering and on participants’ departure/dissolution; do not transfer Franco’s earlier detention.

description: The Monitoreamos lead says the Jan 22 Caracas protest demanded proper functioning of public services but does not identify the responsible state agency, policy, or intended recipient.
required_followup: Seek a direct event-day statement specifying the demanded service and responsible Venezuelan authority or policy before resolving state-target eligibility.

description: The opened report describes a group of people at the Jan 22 Caracas protest, without an individual headcount or qualitative size sufficient to test the 50-person threshold.
required_followup: Find attendance evidence for this exact gathering; do not use a citywide or monthly total.

description: The page identifies Caracas but not a specific venue or route for the Jan 22 public-services protest.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous local account identifying the site and any route without assuming citywide scope.

description: The captured Monitoreamos passages do not establish a physical end, event-specific state response, organizer, or relation to nearby Caracas actions. Guaidó’s remarks are not state accommodation.
required_followup: Seek event-specific reporting on state action and participant departure, and compare organizer/site details with other Caracas events before merging.

description: The exact Efecto Cocuyo URL returned HTTP 403 with no body. Q010 later exposed indexed article text dated 23 January 2023, so this is an out-of-period lead rather than evidence of a Jan 2021 event; publisher-level denial still bars retry, mirror, copy, or another article body.
required_followup: Do not access this publisher’s body. Seek a separately published Jan 2021 report from another publisher for the actual Jan 23 leads.

description: The blocked article’s search-index excerpt describes a crowd as hundreds, but its captured page date is 23 January 2023. That size claim is not evidence about any January 2021 gathering; no Jan 2021 participant value or threshold is assigned.
required_followup: Do not apply this out-of-period search claim. Use independently accessible Jan 2021 event-day sources only.

description: Q010’s search-index text for the denied Efecto Cocuyo URL identifies a 23 January 2023 article. Its route/date excerpt cannot establish the physical date or location of a Jan 2021 event; E006 is retained as an excluded lead with null event date.
required_followup: Do not use this lead for Jan 2021. Verify the separate Jan 2021 NTN24 and Tal Cual leads from their own accessible publishers.

description: NTN24 names unions, NGOs, civil society and several worker sectors but gives no individual attendance count or crowd-size descriptor. Sector/group labels and prior detained-worker totals do not establish this gathering’s 50-person threshold.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous account with an explicit headcount or an adequate qualitative crowd-size description.

description: The NTN24 Jan 23 UCV assembly may overlap the Jan 22 Diario Republica announcement for a teacher concentration at the same entrance, and may overlap the Tal Cual/PROVEA search-only lead. The announced teacher action is not proof of execution; Tal Cual body returned HTTP 403, and its attributed origin remains unverified.
required_followup: Compare any separately authored accessible event-day evidence on route, participant group, time and attribution; do not retry or mirror Tal Cual. Keep actions and shared-source relationships unresolved without evidence.

description: The reviewed NTN24 paragraphs do not report accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, explicit ignoring, killings or shootings at this specific gathering. A general statement about more than 100 prior worker imprisonments is not this-event response evidence.
required_followup: Check event-day reporting for attributed actions by Venezuelan state agents; retain unknown absent direct evidence.

description: The report locates an assembly at UCV but does not document physical departure/dissolution or an end time.
required_followup: Follow event-day coverage for physical closure; do not use last speech, publication, or month end as an event end.

description: The exact Tal Cual Jan 23 UCV protest article returned HTTP 403 Forbidden in web.run and no body. The search result attributes its account to a PROVEA post, but that dependency and event relation could not be verified from the denied page.
required_followup: Do not retry this URL, another Tal Cual article, copy or mirror. If needed, seek a separately authored accessible account; do not treat the search result as independent corroboration.

description: Crónica Uno reports teacher groups at multiple sites and “few” reaching Barquisimeto, but gives no attendance counts. Separate sites or online voices cannot be summed to prove 50 attendees at one event.
required_followup: Seek site-specific counts/qualified crowd descriptions and keep each location’s turnout distinct.

description: The reported Jan 15 multi-region Teachers’ Day actions may be a single coordinated event or several local gatherings. The Caracas Palace of Justice protest in E004 may be related, but Crónica Uno does not identify that venue.
required_followup: Apply original manual unit rules when verified; preserve one national action versus local events as unresolved and do not merge/split solely by same date or sector.

description: The source describes many police officers relative to teachers at the Lara Zone-Educativa gathering but does not report force, clearance or another event-specific state action. Other state responses and protester violence are unreported.
required_followup: Look for event-specific action by state agents; police presence alone is not dispersal or violence.

description: The reports identify Jan 15 activity but do not document a physical end or duration for the Caracas or multi-site action.
required_followup: Find direct evidence of departure or dissolution; do not set an end from publication date, a scheduled program or month boundary.

description: The search result for a CorteIDH-hosted 2021 Venezuela report exposed a truncated indexed fragment mentioning January 15 teachers’ activity, but the exact PDF URL returned HTTP 403 and no body. The preview is not used to establish occurrence or any relationship to E004/E008; report authorship and shared origin remain unknown.
required_followup: Do not retry, copy, mirror, or access another body under this denied repository/publisher. Use separately authored accessible event-day sources; keep attendance, local-versus-national unit boundaries, and common origin unresolved.

description: The recorded pre-access denial scan before opening S018 covered 29 unit source cards and 2,326 coordinator source checks, not the full saved unit-source universe. The total global card count and all publisher/story alias matches were not captured. Later complete scans cannot establish what was present in the pre-access state, so full-universe denial-screen compliance for this one request remains unverified.
required_followup: Preserve this provenance limitation; do not retrofit later scan results as proof. Use and record a full saved-universe publisher, alias, agency and shared-origin scan before any future original-body request.

description: S022 reports activists from various organizations at the Caracas gathering but gives no individual count or qualitative crowd-size estimate. Organizations and plural wording do not establish 50 attendees.
required_followup: Seek a direct site-specific attendance estimate or clear crowd description; retain pending_threshold without one.

description: The captured S022 passages do not state when participants departed or the gathering physically dissolved.
required_followup: Follow event-day reporting for physical closure; do not use publication time or month end as the event end.

description: S022 does not report an event-specific response by state authorities or protester violence in the passages retained for analysis; all response dimensions and protester violence remain unknown.
required_followup: Check separately authored event-day accounts for actions attributable to state agents during this gathering; do not infer response from the ministry venue or the workers’ prior detention.

description: S022 establishes one Jan. 20 Caracas assembly. Same-publisher S021 may be an alternate or overlapping report, while search-only S019 describes a similar Caracas release demand; their written-origin relationship is unresolved. The relation of this Caracas action to the distinct Lara site in E003 is also unresolved. These leads do not establish extra events or independent corroboration.
required_followup: Compare accessible bylines, wording, and organizer statements if available; retain one Caracas candidate and a separate Lara candidate until coordination or duplication is evidenced.
